payload.title: Anth.us Amplify app link: create GitHub token secret and set repositoryAccessTokenSecretArn (Mac)
payload.description: Papyrus PR 335 lets the app shell set the Amplify repository from site.json via repositoryAccessTokenSecretArn (Secrets Manager). Remaining, on the Mac: create the GitHub token secret in the papyrus-production account, add its ARN to the Anth.us site.json by PR, and let the stack pipeline deploy it, so Amplify app d7s858igkyct5 moves off anthusai/anth.us-papyrus. No manual deploy.
